title: The Hasmoneans
lead: The priestly family of Mattathias and his sons Judas, Jonathan and Simon, and the dynasty that ruled Judea from Simon's time (142 BC) until Rome took control (63 BC). They were high priests and, from about 104 BC, kings. 1 Maccabees was written to honor them; others, including the Qumran community, the Pharisees and the Psalms of Solomon, judged them harshly.
